title: A Conversation with My Future Self
style: Realistic illustrated; soft cinematic lighting; smooth natural movement

scenes.title: The unfinished page
scenes.visual: Late evening. A young creator sits with an unfinished notebook. A quiet breath before speaking.
lines: I thought I'd be further by now.

scenes.title: A familiar stranger
scenes.visual: An older version appears nearby. Warm light gently enters the room.

scenes.title: Recognition
scenes.visual: A close look at the same eyes, familiar clothes and greying hair. Surprise softens into curiosity.
lines: With a few more grey hairs.
Then tell me. Does it work out?

scenes.title: An honest answer
scenes.visual: The older self gives a small, honest smile. No grand promise.
lines: Do you remember why you started?

scenes.title: Remembering
scenes.visual: The younger self looks toward the unfinished page. Their expression begins to lift.
lines: I wanted to make something that mattered.
That part of you is still here.

scenes.title: One small thing
scenes.visual: A gentle hand gesture toward the notebook. The younger self turns back to their work.
lines: Start with one small thing. It doesn't have to be perfect. It just has to be yours.

scenes.title: We try again
scenes.visual: A shared smile. The younger self begins a new line. Hold the hopeful final frame.
